Hadith.2366 - Al-Nadr narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan:
I heard Abu Abdullah (as) say: "

For the pigeons of Mecca and the domesticated birds from the pigeons of the Sacred Sanctuary (Haram), whoever slaughters a bird from them must give charity greater than its value. If the person was in the state of Ihram, then a sheep is required for each bird."
